decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8903. Series context: trend strength 0.8651 and seasonal strength 0.0735; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.212); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 3.412.
